node_definition.done_when: Done when a test runs the service loop with a promotion executor that blocks on an event, moves the code stamp while that promotion runs, and records calls to the re-exec. No re-exec happens while the promotion thread is alive. No second promotion starts after the stamp moved, though one is requested. Once the event is set, the loop re-executes within one pass. The same holds for a landing in flight. The negative control is the base revision, where the re-exec is called while the promotion thread is alive. The test files importing the changed modules add no failure against the base revision, run on all_debug one arm at a time with at most -n 4 , submitted with env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch and never on the fleet node. Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/admission/service.py , reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py and tests/test_a_reload_never_cuts_off_a_promotion.py .
